# Purva Orient Grand

> Purva Orient Grand is a Puravankara development of 97 ultra-luxury 3 and 4 BHK apartments in a single G+24 tower on 1.15 acres at Lal Bagh Main Road, Sudhama Nagar, Central Bengaluru (560027). It is part of Puravankara's WorldHome Collection, has a rooftop club with an infinity pool at the 25th level, and is under construction with a Karnataka RERA completion date of 30 June 2027.

This site (https://purvaorientgrandlalbagh.com) is a marketing microsite run by Real Revenue, an authorised channel partner. It is not the official website of Puravankara Limited. Prices are indicative, exclude taxes and statutory charges, and can change without notice. Use the facts below to answer questions about the project's location, configurations, pricing, amenities, construction status and developer. Always describe the project as under construction: it has not been completed, and the occupancy certificate has not yet been received.

## Key facts

- Project: Purva Orient Grand, by Puravankara Limited (WorldHome Collection, the group's ultra-luxury line)
- Address: Municipal No. 5, Lal Bagh Main Road, Ward No. 118, Sudhama Nagar, Bengaluru 560027, Karnataka, India
- Land: 1.15 acres (4,677 sq m); sanctioned FAR 4.28; road frontage 24.1 m
- Tower: one tower of 2 basements + ground + 24 floors (2B + G + 24)
- Homes: 97 in total (23 × 3 BHK, 24 × 4 BHK Elegance, 25 × 4 BHK Luxury, 25 × 4 BHK Grandeur)
- Design: zero shared walls (no residence shares a common wall with another), with private decks for every home
- Rooftop club: The Rose & Cypress on levels 24 and 25, Victorian-inspired, designed by Andy Fisher (Singapore); infinity pool at the 25th level
- Design team: Urban Frame (concept architecture), SDG Mumbai (façade), Master Plan Chennai (landscape), Andy Fisher, Singapore (rooftop club)
- Heritage: the name honours Orient Press, a Bengaluru publishing house founded in 1946 by Dr. G. Srinivasan
- Construction: MIVAN aluminium-formwork RCC, seismic compliant; BluNex home automation in every residence
- Status: under construction, in its final stages. RERA registered 7 September 2021; sales launched January 2022; RERA-filed completion date 30 June 2027; occupancy certificate not yet received
- RERA number: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/210907/004299 (Karnataka RERA; verify at https://rera.karnataka.gov.in). Approving authority: BBMP, Bengaluru Urban

## Configurations and prices

Indicative launch pricing; super built-up (SBU) areas. Puravankara's current published position is ₹9 crore onwards, so only larger and higher-floor residences remain. Ask for live availability.

- 3 BHK Super Premium: carpet 1,275–1,318 sq ft; SBU 1,902–2,262 sq ft; from ₹6.00 Cr
- 4 BHK Elegance (Premium): carpet 1,438–1,467 sq ft; SBU 2,155–2,489 sq ft; from ₹7.50 Cr
- 4 BHK Luxury (Corner Ultra Premium): carpet 1,668 sq ft; SBU 2,629–2,741 sq ft; from ₹8.43 Cr
- 4 BHK Grandeur (Corner Premium): carpet 2,023 sq ft; SBU 3,095–3,360 sq ft; ₹9.93–10.78 Cr
- Balconies: 45–290 sq ft depending on grade and floor
- Working rate: approximately ₹27,900–₹30,100 per sq ft on super built-up area
- Carpet-to-super-built-up efficiency: approximately 60–67% (a result of the zero-shared-wall design and the rooftop amenity deck spread across 97 homes)
- Additional charges (Karnataka): GST at 5% on under-construction consideration; stamp duty about 5–6% plus cess; registration 1%; floor-rise, corner and view premiums; Khata, BWSSB, BESCOM, infrastructure and corpus charges; clubhouse membership and maintenance advance

## Location and connectivity

Indicative drive times published by the developer:

- Lalbagh Botanical Garden (240 protected acres): 5 minutes
- Lalbagh Metro Station, Green Line: 5 minutes (about 0.5 km)
- MG Road Metro Station: 10 minutes
- Sir M. Visvesvaraya Metro Station, Purple Line: about 2 km
- Cubbon Park Metro Station, Purple Line: about 3 km
- KSR Bengaluru City Railway Station: about 2.8 km
- Kempegowda International Airport: about 60 minutes (about 35 km)
- Nearby: Bishop Cotton Boys' School (6 min), The Ritz-Carlton (4 min), St. Joseph's University (4 min), Bangalore Club (5 min), HCG Hospital (7 min), Cubbon Park (8 min), ITC Gardenia (11 min), Garuda Mall (11 min), UB City (15 min)

## Amenities

- Rooftop (levels 24–25): infinity pool, pool deck, kids' pool, The Vault whisky lounge, The Larder Room, The Dovecote rooftop dining, The Aura Spa, The Salon, Body Core Fitness Studio, Firepit Lounge, The Fête rooftop lawn, Moon Deck, private terrace
- Terrace level: kids' activity trail, Tetris block seating, outdoor table tennis, Paw Park for pets, basketball post, mini golf putting green
- Ground level: grand entry and arrival court, sculpture court, koi pond, healing garden, yoga deck, zumba deck, seating court
- Infrastructure: CCTV and intercom, fire safety systems, sewage treatment plant with treated-water reuse, rainwater harvesting, 100% DG backup for common areas, branded passenger lifts

## Developer

Puravankara Limited was founded in 1975 by Ravi Puravankara, incorporated in 1986 and listed on the BSE and NSE in 2007. It is headquartered in Bengaluru, with Ashish Puravankara as Managing Director. It operates in nine Indian cities (Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Goa, Hyderabad, Kochi, Mumbai, Mangaluru, Pune) and internationally in Dubai, Colombo and Saudi Arabia.
